newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Cimpor wants Brazil cement firms - paper.
newsitem.headline: Cimpor wants Brazil cement firms - paper.

text.p: Portugal's Cimpor-Cimentos de Portugal is negotiating to buy Brazilian cement companies Cimentos Caue and Cimentos Serrana, the Portuguese daily Publico said on Wednesday.
Quoting a spokesman for Brazil's National Cement Industry Union, Publico said that other Brazilian and international companies were also interested in buying the two firms.
The paper said talks between Cimpor and the companies had been delayed and any deal would probably not go through until early 1997.

Publico said Caue, which has production capacity of 2.2 million tonnes per year, was valued at between 25 and 30 billion escudos, while Serrana, with capacity of 1.8 million tonnes, was worth around 20 billion escudos.
Cimpor officials were unavailable to comment on the report.
